## Purpose

Standalone walkthrough of the generic GLMM model factory
(`3_analysis/R/functions_statistics.R`) applied to the `yield_dry` and
`quality_n` outcomes, plus the 2 existing preliminary yield figures
(unchanged) and a new estimated-marginal-means plot per outcome. Calls
`2_preprocessing/R/functions_yield_quality.R` and
`3_analysis/R/functions_yield_analysis.R` directly.

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(car)
library(emmeans)

source(here("2_preprocessing", "R", "functions_yield_quality.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "functions_yield_analysis.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "functions_statistics.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "utils.R"))
source(here("3_analysis", "R", "plot_theme.R"))
```

## Step 1: Build the analysis-ready dataset

```{r build-data}
#| message: false
study2_yield_analysis_ready <- build_study2_yield_dataset(
  xlsx_2023 = here("1_input_data", "crop_yield_quality", "2023", "HYPERFARM_YIELD_DATA_2023_v2.xlsx"),
  xlsx_2024 = here("1_input_data", "crop_yield_quality", "2024", "HYPERFARM_VALUE4FARM_YIELD_DATA_2024_v3.xlsx"),
  xlsx_2025 = here("1_input_data", "crop_yield_quality", "2025", "VALUE4FARM_YIELD_DATA_2025.xlsx")
)
```

## Step 2: Preliminary figures (existing, unchanged)

```{r fig-yield-treatment}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
plot_yield_by_treatment(study2_yield_analysis_ready)
```

```{r fig-yield-location}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
plot_yield_by_location(study2_yield_analysis_ready)
```

## Step 3: Fit, diagnose, and test the yield model

`fit_yield_dry_model()`: `DRY_WEIGHT_TON_HA ~ GLOBAL_SUB_STRIP_LOCATION +
FERTILISATION + RESIDUE + CROP_PRODUCT + YEAR + FERTILISATION:RESIDUE`,
`dispformula = ~ ROW + COLUMN`, Gamma(link = "log").

```{r fit-yield}
yield_fit <- fit_yield_dry_model(study2_yield_analysis_ready)
summary(yield_fit)
```

```{r diagnose-yield}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
yield_diag <- diagnose_glmm(yield_fit)
plot(yield_diag$sim)
```

```{r anova-yield}
anova_glmm(yield_fit)
```

## Step 4: Estimated marginal means (new figure)

```{r emm-yield}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
yield_emm <- emm_yield_dry_model(yield_fit)
plot_emmeans_effect(
  as.data.frame(yield_emm$emmeans),
  x_var = "RESIDUE", colour_var = "FERTILISATION",
  colour_values = fertilisation_colors, y_lab = "Dry-matter yield (t/ha)"
)
```

## Step 5: Quality (total N%) model

Same structure, without `YEAR` (quality data currently exist only for the
2024 season -- see `fit_quality_model()`'s docstring). No preliminary
figures exist for this outcome, so the emmeans plot below is its only
figure.

```{r fit-quality}
quality_fit <- fit_quality_model(study2_yield_analysis_ready)
anova_glmm(quality_fit)
```

```{r emm-quality}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
quality_emm <- emm_quality_model(quality_fit)
plot_emmeans_effect(
  as.data.frame(quality_emm$emmeans),
  x_var = "RESIDUE", colour_var = "FERTILISATION",
  colour_values = fertilisation_colors, y_lab = "Total N (%)"
)
```
